text:
Alex: Heads-up — Monolith private/VPC deploy window this Friday 21:00 PDT. Need owners, quick smoke checklist, and rollback readiness. Who can take lead?
Maya: I can lead the smoke checks. Planning a 21:00–22:00 quiet window.
Ravi: I’ll own the deployment kickoff and can stay for rollback for 30 mins after deploy.
Cheng: I’ll be on infra and VPN/bastion support. Can confirm network policies + HSM access earlier in the day.
Sarah: I’ll do preflight PR reviews. Ping me the PRs by EOD tomorrow.
Alex: Thanks — Maya + Ravi primary, Cheng backup for infra. ops-bot, can you create a runbook stub in #runbooks for Monolith? :clipboard:
ops-bot: Runbook created: https://confluence.redwood/monolith-deploy-runbook (placeholder) :white_check_mark:
Maya: Smoke checklist draft (short):
```
- verify bastion access
- `curl -sS https://monolith-internal.health/ready | jq .` -> expect {"ok":true}
- run `scripts/smoke/mini_end2end.sh --customer monolith`
- sample generation sanity (2 prompts) — check latency < 200ms p50
- embedding/kv cache warmup: `./tools/warmup_kv.sh 1000`
```
Ravi: Rollback plan (summary):
- step 1: disable LB -> route traffic to fallback model group
- step 2: run infra rollback playbook: `ansible-playbook rollback_monolith.yml --limit=monolith`
- step 3: restore DB snapshot (if schema change) -> snapshot tag `pre-monolith-174560`
- step 4: confirm smoke checks pass on fallback
(Full steps in runbook)
Cheng: Quick infra notes: customer uses private control plane + KMS. I need to rotate deploy keys by 18:00 Fri for test. Also, confirm we have node pool scale margin +1 to take down nodes.
Maya: Can someone double-check PR #487 (model-pin + config tweak) — it's in staging and needs one more approval before cutoff 18:30 Fri. https://git.redwood/monolith/pull/487
Sarah: Reviewing now. Quick note: the config change has a default timeout bump — fine but add a config flag. Will approve if tests pass.
Ravi: We'll keep a 15-min hold after deploy for live traffic before full cutover. If anything, we can flip back within 10 minutes.
Alex: Who's on post-deploy monitoring? I can do the first 30m, Maya can take next hour. Need specific dashboards: per-route latency, error rate, tokens/sec, KV cache hit%.
Maya: I'll add dashboard links to runbook. Also will run the scripted smoke including two regression prompts.
Cheng: Reminder: customer bastion cert expires Thu 23:00 PDT — I’ll renew and post new conn string.
Ravi: Ops note — QA will run smoke 20:30 Fri internal; if green, we go at 21:00. If any fail -> abort and rollback.
Alex: Can someone post the exact rollback command snippets in runbook before EOD Thurs? Want copy-paste readiness.
Sarah: Will add commands + a `--dry-run` section.
Maya: I pushed `scripts/smoke/mini_end2end.sh` update to include a KV warmup step. Tagging @Sarah for one-liner test.
Sarah: LGTM, minor nit in logging string. Approving PR after CI. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: deploy window — Monolith — Fri 21:00 PDT (created by Alex)
Ravi: Final checklist for Fri:
- 18:00 key rotations done (Cheng)
- 18:30 PR approvals complete (Sarah)
- 20:30 internal smoke (QA)
- 20:50 infra preflight (Cheng)
- 21:00 deploy kickoff (Ravi)
- 21:15 initial smoke (Maya)
- 21:30 traffic cutover decision
- 22:00 full rollback cutoff (if issues)
Alex: Perfect. If anything changes, update this thread. Thanks all. :pray:
